home.heroSubtitle: Point us at a location and we'll tell you whether solar works there — usually in under a minute.
home.emptyChecksDescription: Your first rooftop check will show up here with its suitability score and system size.

result.roofInfoUnknown: We're still working out how much space is on your roof.
result.roofInfoHasSpace: You have space on your roof for solar panels.
result.roofInfoNoSpace: There isn't much clear space left on your roof for solar panels.
result.sunlightDescGood: Your roof gets plenty of sunlight.
result.sunlightDescFair: Your roof gets a fair amount of sunlight.
result.shadeNoteLow: — less shade means more solar power.
result.shadeNoteMedium: — some shade may reduce your solar power a little.
result.shadeNoteHigh: — shade is likely reducing your solar power.
result.panelsDescription: We can fit {count} solar panels on your roof.
result.savingsDescHasSavings: Solar can lower your electricity bill and pay for itself over time.
result.savingsDescNoSavings: Here's what solar could cost — savings depend on how much electricity you use.
result.financialProjectionDesc: A year-by-year look at what this system could earn back over its life, based on your actual roof size and generation estimate.
result.obstructionsDescriptionOne: There is {count} thing on your roof. We won't place solar panels there.
result.obstructionsDescriptionOther: There are {count} things on your roof. We won't place solar panels there.
result.verdictExplainerSuitable: Your location looks like a strong fit for solar. There's enough usable space and no blockers showed up in our checks.
result.verdictExplainerSuitableSubjectToSurvey: Your location looks promising. Before anything is finalised, someone should visit in person to confirm a couple of details we can't fully see from imagery alone.
result.verdictExplainerConditional: Solar can work here, but it will need a bit of extra paperwork or a different connection arrangement to go ahead.
result.verdictExplainerInsufficientData: We don't have quite enough information yet to give you a confident answer — that's not a bad sign, it just means we need a clearer look. Try again shortly, or an on-site visit can settle it.
result.verdictExplainerNotSuitable: Based on what we found, this exact spot isn't a good match for solar right now. That's useful to know early, and it doesn't reflect on you or the property overall.
result.obstructionsNoneFound: We didn't spot anything on your roof. If we've missed something, tell us.
result.obstructionsNotLookedYet: We haven't been able to check your roof for water tanks, AC units and the like. You can tell us what's there.
result.obstructionsMarkCta: Tell us what's on your roof

wizard.step1Subtitle: Search for your address, use your current location, or tap the map to drop a pin.
